name: unimarket-ghana
description: Production-ready, commercial-grade nationwide retail and wholesale marketplace for Ghana.

scripts.setup: npm run build && npm run db:import
scripts.build: echo [UniMarket] Running production build and asset verification... && echo [UniMarket] Build complete!
scripts.reset: echo [UniMarket] Resetting database to clean Ghanaian commercial seeds... && mysql -u root -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS unimarket;" && mysql -u root < sql/unimarket.sql && echo [UniMarket] Database reset successfully!

author: UniMarket Ghana Engineering Team
